name: rpgp-certificate-merge
instr:
Please add certificate merging to rpgp in `/app`, so callers can reconcile overlapping copies without duplicate or invalid bindings. Add consuming methods `pgp::composed::SignedPublicKey::merge(self, other: Self) -> pgp::errors::Result<Self>`, `pgp::composed::SignedSecretKey::merge(self, other: Self) -> pgp::errors::Result<Self>`, `pgp::composed::SignedSecretKey::merge_public(self, other: SignedPublicKey) -> pgp::errors::Result<Self>` and `pgp::composed::PublicOrSecret::merge(self, other: Self) -> pgp::errors::Result<Self>`. Don't add new crates.

Reject unequal primary public packet bodies; otherwise retain the left primary packet, including secret protection. Body equality and ordering mean lexicographic `Serialize::to_bytes()` without packet headers.

Union direct signatures, key revocations, user IDs, attributes and subkeys, including duplicates within either input. Group identities by packet body and subkeys by public packet body. Pool signatures before pruning components with no survivors; empty fragments are allowed.

Only cryptographically verified primary-key signatures over the relevant component survive: `Key` for direct signatures, `KeyRevocation` for key revocations, `CertGeneric`, `CertPersona`, `CertCasual`, `CertPositive` or `CertRevocation` for identities, and `SubkeyBinding` or `SubkeyRevocation` for subkeys. Revocations are evidence, not deletion commands. Keep distinct signatures regardless of creation time.
